Class AbstractPassive

java.lang.Object
httyd.model.skill.AbstractPassive
All Implemented Interfaces:
PassiveSkill
Direct Known Subclasses:
Passives.Aura, Passives.Conductor, Passives.CritResist, Passives.DamageReduction, Passives.DamageUp, Passives.DebuffImmunity, Passives.DefStack, Passives.DodgeUp, Passives.FasterAttack, Passives.FlatBonus, Passives.LazySlumber, Passives.LowHpDefense, Passives.NeverDodged, Passives.NoPassive, Passives.PoisonSignature, Passives.ReflectAttack, Passives.ReflectDamage, Passives.SparksJet, Passives.SurviveOnce, Passives.TypelessCrit
public abstract class AbstractPassive extends Object implements PassiveSkill
Base class of all passives. It stores the name, the description and the strength factor (1.0 normally, 1.5 for a 3-star "Titan Wing" dragon).
